findings.claim: The plan says spike:fix-audit-drift/1's stdout holds all three report.json files, but run.json has truncated: true and stdout.txt is cut at 20000 bytes. It starts partway through okf-vs-code and holds only 11 of the 35 findings (okf-vs-code's last 4 and okf-vs-docs's 7). All of docs-vs-code and 17 okf-vs-code findings, including the one high, the manifesto, index and architecture findings and ADRs 0001/0002/0011/0012, are missing. The full reports exist only in this session's scratchpad (real-audits-main/out-*/report.json), which the build worktree cannot rely on. The Done-when then cannot be checked against the input it names. Rerun the spike so the evidence is complete, for example one spike per audit, or print only title, severity, path, claim, contradicted_by and fix for each finding so the output fits under the limit.

Several findings sit in a decision's front matter `description` and the decisions index line copied from it, not in the body: okf-vs-code #16 (ADR 0012 still names the plugin manifest as the version source), #20 (index line for ADR 0014), and by the same reasoning the index lines for 0001, 0011, 0013 and 0015 that still name kmctl plugin install. A `## Correction` cannot change those lines. The git history shows no decision description ever edited after creation, and okf-bundle.md says a record is never rewritten. So the plan must pick one: edit the description and its index line (and say this does not break append-only), or leave the description and annotate the index line the way '(superseded by ADR 00NN)' already does. If neither is chosen, the builder decides an append-only question on their own, and if the descriptions stay, a fresh audit re-reports these findings, which fails the Done-when.

The Intent limits fixes to docs/ and .okf/, but some of the wrong text comes from the CLI. docs/reference/commands.md's summary rows copy the command docstrings, and okf-vs-docs says this about the briefing and review-due rows. For example, src/kmctl/__init__.py:300 still says 'List concepts in .okf/ due for review' while ADR 0022 makes review due cover docs/ as well. If the builder fixes only commands.md, `kmctl review due --help`, the text an agent reads before it acts, stays wrong, and the docs and the help no longer match. The scope should include the CLI help strings these rows copy, along with the tests that pin commands.md and the help text (tests/test_init.py, test_docs_frontmatter.py, test_apm_package.py, test_plugin_patch.py).

The Done-when line 'a fresh run of the three audits ... reports none of the fixed findings again' depends on a model whose output varies from run to run (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) and on a judgment of whether a new report is 'the same finding'. Nothing says what happens when a fixed finding comes back reworded, or when a not-real finding (such as docs-vs-code #3, the APM token order that no code here decides) is reported again. As written, the ticket can loop forever or be closed by argument. Say how many reruns there are (one), that a returning finding is checked against the code again and then either fixed or recorded as not real with the evidence, and that new findings outside the 35 are out of scope (a follow-up ticket). The eval has no rows, so nothing else pins this.
